title: 矩阵中的幻方
summary: 统计网格中有多少个 3×3 子矩阵包含一到九各一次，且每行、列和两条对角线的和都相等。
insight: 一到九各一次时总和为 45，幻方每条线必为 15；枚举每个 3×3 窗口检查范围、唯一性及八条线。
pitfalls: 元素必须恰在一到九范围内
不足三行或三列时答案为零

solutions.title: 枚举 3×3 窗口完整校验
solutions.idea: 逐窗口检查数字集合和所有线之和。
steps: 用 seen[10] 检查九格均在 1..9 且不重复
检查三行、三列及两对角线和均为 15，通过则 answer++

code.java: class Solution { public int numMagicSquaresInside(int[][] grid){int answer=0;for(int r=0;r+2<grid.length;r++)for(int c=0;c+2<grid[0].length;c++)if(magic(grid,r,c))answer++;return answer;}private boolean magic(int[][] grid,int r,int c){boolean[] seen=new boolean[10];for(int i=0;i<3;i++)for(int j=0;j<3;j++){int value=grid[r+i][c+j];if(value<1||value>9||seen[value])return false;seen[value]=true;}for(int i=0;i<3;i++)if(grid[r+i][c]+grid[r+i][c+1]+grid[r+i][c+2]!=15||grid[r][c+i]+grid[r+1][c+i]+grid[r+2][c+i]!=15)return false;return grid[r][c]+grid[r+1][c+1]+grid[r+2][c+2]==15&&grid[r][c+2]+grid[r+1][c+1]+grid[r+2][c]==15;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun numMagicSquaresInside(grid:Array<IntArray>):Int{var answer=0;for(r in 0 until grid.size-2)for(c in 0 until grid[0].size-2)if(magic(grid,r,c))answer++;return answer};private fun magic(grid:Array<IntArray>,r:Int,c:Int):Boolean{val seen=BooleanArray(10);for(i in 0 until 3)for(j in 0 until 3){val value=grid[r+i][c+j];if(value !in 1..9||seen[value])return false;seen[value]=true};for(i in 0 until 3)if(grid[r+i][c]+grid[r+i][c+1]+grid[r+i][c+2]!=15||grid[r][c+i]+grid[r+1][c+i]+grid[r+2][c+i]!=15)return false;return grid[r][c]+grid[r+1][c+1]+grid[r+2][c+2]==15&&grid[r][c+2]+grid[r+1][c+1]+grid[r+2][c]==15} }
code.cpp: class Solution { bool magic(vector<vector<int>>& grid,int r,int c){bool seen[10]{};for(int i=0;i<3;++i)for(int j=0;j<3;++j){int value=grid[r+i][c+j];if(value<1||value>9||seen[value])return false;seen[value]=true;}for(int i=0;i<3;++i)if(grid[r+i][c]+grid[r+i][c+1]+grid[r+i][c+2]!=15||grid[r][c+i]+grid[r+1][c+i]+grid[r+2][c+i]!=15)return false;return grid[r][c]+grid[r+1][c+1]+grid[r+2][c+2]==15&&grid[r][c+2]+grid[r+1][c+1]+grid[r+2][c]==15;}public:int numMagicSquaresInside(vector<vector<int>>& grid){int answer=0;for(int r=0;r+2<(int)grid.size();++r)for(int c=0;c+2<(int)grid[0].size();++c)answer+=magic(grid,r,c);return answer;} };
